correctness.rationale: For nonempty finite refinement-closed partition family, shattering an edge set containing a cycle contradicts transitivity (all but one edges positive). For a forest, shattering implies component partition π_S feasible via all-ones labeling; conversely feasibility plus refinement closure lets every choice of positive forest edges define a permitted component partition. Thus maximal shattered forests have |V|−min b(π) edges, proving VCdim. The union-find online predictor makes mistakes only on target-positive mergers, at most the same number; the shattered forest gives the Littlestone lower bound. Contracting positive transcript components preserves refinement closure, with negatives prohibiting mergers. For independent-set partitions, min blocks=χ(G), including quotient graph after consistent history. Independently enumerated all partitions and graph concepts for 74 graph instances n=2..4, comparing VC, recursive Littlestone and n−χ exactly. This finite check corroborates the unrestricted combinatorial proof.
